item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. With no notes from you today, keep it simple: medication works best when it's automatic, not something you remember in the moment. Your day already has anchors, like the morning routine and the evening wind-down. Attach your doses to those, so they happen without a decision. If you miss one, don't spiral or double up. Just return to the schedule. Action: tie each dose to one existing routine, and say which one out loud.
